description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with AWS Step Functions (SFN). It declares method signatures for various AWS Step Functions API operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, and extends the base AWS client class.

classes.name: SfnClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with AWS Step Functions, providing methods corresponding to AWS SFN API operations.

methods.name: createActivity
methods.description: Creates a new activity in AWS Step Functions.

methods.name: createActivityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new activity in AWS Step Functions.

methods.name: createStateMachineAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new state machine.
